title: 2.3 Natural and Human Induced Climate Change
description: Milankovitch cycles, solar output, volcanic aerosols, land use change and greenhouse gas emissions. Easy level.

questions.question: What are the three external causes of climate change?
options: Changes in incoming solar radiation, atmospheric composition and Earth surface
questions.correctAnswer: Changes in incoming solar radiation, atmospheric composition and Earth surface

questions.question: What are internal causes of climate change?
options: Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
questions.correctAnswer: Ocean and atmosphere circulation that redistributes energy
